description: Source code for bcm4908img utility, handling BCM4908 firmware images including parsing, creating, extracting, and managing boot filesystem.

methods.name: bcm4908img_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum for a buffer.

methods.name: bcm4908img_open
methods.description: Opens a file or stdin with safety checks.

methods.name: bcm4908img_close
methods.description: Closes a file if not stdin.

methods.name: bcm4908img_calc_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum of a firmware image segment.

methods.name: bcm4908img_parse
methods.description: Parses a BCM4908 firmware image to extract metadata and validate.

methods.name: bcm4908img_info
methods.description: Displays information about a BCM4908 firmware image.

methods.name: bcm4908img_create_append_file
methods.description: Appends file data to firmware image during creation.

methods.name: bcm4908img_create_append_zeros
methods.description: Appends zeros to firmware image for padding.

methods.name: bcm4908img_create_align
methods.description: Aligns firmware image with zeros to specified boundary.

methods.name: bcm4908img_create
methods.description: Creates a new BCM4908 firmware image with specified options.

methods.name: bcm4908img_extract
methods.description: Extracts specified segments from a BCM4908 firmware image.

methods.name: bcm4908img_bootfs_ls
methods.description: Lists files in the boot filesystem of the image.

methods.name: bcm4908img_bootfs_mv
methods.description: Renames a file within the boot filesystem.
